<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_FarmingBot" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/farming-bot">
  <bpmn:signal id="Signal_NaturalDisaster" name="Natural disaster strikes"/>
  <bpmn:signal id="Signal_MilestoneReached" name="Milestone reached"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_UpdateFarmingList" name="Update farming list"/>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_FarmingBot" name="Farming Bot" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_FarmingBot">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Player" name="Player">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_Request</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SelectResources</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SetUrgency</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_UpdateList</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Share_Split</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Brag</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendMaterials</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Share_Join</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_Completed</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_ListUpdated</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_FarmingBot" name="Farming Bot">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ResolveDependencies</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Farming_Start</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_FarmResources</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>BoundaryEvent_Disaster</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Recover</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>BoundaryEvent_Milestone</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_NotifyMilestone</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_MilestoneNotified</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>BoundaryEvent_Update</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Request" name="Bot creation requested"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectResources" name="Select resources to farm">
      <bpmn:documentation>Player selects the resources to farm (up to 10 can be collected in parallel).</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:businessRuleTask id="Task_ResolveDependencies" name="Resolve tool dependencies">
      <bpmn:documentation>Custom logic: resources required to create tools needed for gathering other resources are added.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:businessRuleTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SetUrgency" name="Set resource urgency">
      <bpmn:documentation>Player sets which resources are more urgently needed.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Farming_Start" name="Start or resume farming"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_FarmResources" name="Farm selected resources">
      <bpmn:documentation>Bot gathers the selected resources, up to 10 in parallel.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics isSequential="false"/>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:boundaryEvent id="BoundaryEvent_Disaster" name="Natural disaster" attachedToRef="Task_FarmResources" cancelActivity="true">
      <bpmn:signalEventDefinition id="SignalED_Disaster" signalRef="Signal_NaturalDisaster"/>
    </bpmn:boundaryEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_Recover" name="Recover bot after disaster">
      <bpmn:documentation>Bot is set back by a random natural disaster and recovers before farming resumes.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:boundaryEvent id="BoundaryEvent_Milestone" name="Milestone reached" attachedToRef="Task_FarmResources" cancelActivity="false">
      <bpmn:signalEventDefinition id="SignalED_Milestone" signalRef="Signal_MilestoneReached"/>
    </bpmn:boundaryEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_NotifyMilestone" name="Notify player of milestone"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_MilestoneNotified" name="Milestone notified"/>
    <bpmn:boundaryEvent id="BoundaryEvent_Update" name="Update farming list requested" attachedToRef="Task_FarmResources" cancelActivity="false">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageED_Update" messageRef="Message_UpdateFarmingList"/>
    </bpmn:boundaryEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_UpdateList" name="Update list of materials to farm">
      <bpmn:documentation>Player may update the list of materials to be farmed at any time during farming.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ListUpdated" name="Farming list updated"/>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Share_Split" name="Brag and/or send materials"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_Brag" name="Brag to selected friends"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendMaterials" name="Send materials to selected friends"/>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Share_Join" name="Sharing done"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Completed" name="Bot run completed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="StartEvent_Request" targetRef="Task_SelectResources"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_SelectResources" targetRef="Task_ResolveDependencies"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Task_ResolveDependencies" targetRef="Task_SetUrgency"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="Task_SetUrgency" targetRef="Gateway_Farming_Start"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="Gateway_Farming_Start" targetRef="Task_FarmResources"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" sourceRef="Task_FarmResources" targetRef="Gateway_Share_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" sourceRef="BoundaryEvent_Disaster" targetRef="Task_Recover"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="Task_Recover" targetRef="Gateway_Farming_Start"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" sourceRef="BoundaryEvent_Milestone" targetRef="Task_NotifyMilestone"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Task_NotifyMilestone" targetRef="EndEvent_MilestoneNotified"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="BoundaryEvent_Update" targetRef="Task_UpdateList"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Task_UpdateList" targetRef="EndEvent_ListUpdated"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Gateway_Share_Split" targetRef="Task_Brag"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Gateway_Share_Split" targetRef="Task_SendMaterials"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Task_Brag" targetRef="Gateway_Share_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="Task_SendMaterials" targetRef="Gateway_Share_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" sourceRef="Gateway_Share_Join" targetRef="EndEvent_Completed"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
